question: In December 2020, who among the following presented the Legion of Merit Award to the Prime Minister of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Donald Trump**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The legion of merit** is one of the USA’**s highest military decorations**.
 
• The award was instituted in **1943**.
 
• The award is given to members of the **USA armed forces** and members of **foreign armed forces** and **heads **of **state **or **government**.
 
• The badge is a **five-rayed white cross**, **edged with red**, placed on a **green wreath** with a** blue centre consisting of 13 white stars**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was **conferred **with the **highest Decoration** **The Legion of Merit**, **Degree Chief Commander **by **US President Donald Trump **on **21st December 2020**
 
• **PM Narendra Modi **was awarded for his role in “**Advancing the India-USA relationship**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c7822187835fbfa8c10a2be989c9a69d711baea8ab49e2f4832ab8dd8b477aa.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Legion of Merit, Degree Chief Commander**, was **also awarded** to the PM of Australia **Scott Morrison**, and former PM of Japan **Shinzo Abe**.
 
• Only two Indians were conferred with **The Legion of Merit** award **before **PM Narendra Modi:
 
 
• **General S M Srinagesh**, Indian Army, on **2ⁿd September 1955**.
 
• **Field Marshal K M Cariappa**, Indian Army, **1950**.
